sha256Use: diagnostics only; never a full-file gate
addressing: code segment is PT_LOAD-identity (VA == file offset); GOT slots are RUNTIME vaddrs added to dlpi_addr (this lib is NOT PT_LOAD-identity in its writable segments)

carrier.idGuard: single-byte record id (0..255) in VTS::RXMessage; no 0x73-style bound on this base (the holder auto-instantiates unknown ids)
carrier.readCallShape: fn(base + 0x16a2c4)(svlRoot + 0xa08, id, out, 4); returns the COPIED BYTE COUNT in w0 (0xffffffff when the id's holder is absent): present means copied == requested (4); a partial copy or absence reads as 'not present', which keeps synthesis disabled

clientUnusedEvidence.note: the two hits are libc++ time_get_storage locale helpers; no client value-transport read or publish uses id 0x48

rxIngest.holderAutoInstantiate: operator new(0x40) @0x16a7f8 + bl 0x16a800; the receiver creates unknown ids on first arrival and installs them into the [this+0x100] slot arrays at id*16 (0x16a8ac)

readReturnSemantics.5002363: bool in w0: present AND the full requested size copied
readReturnSemantics.5001712: u32 copied byte count in w0; 0xffffffff = absent; the layer treats present as copied == 4, so both bases enforce the same full-copy policy client-side

bGetRemoteValue.callABI: x0 = the VTS object (SVLRoot + 0xa08), w1 = id, x2 = out, w3 = size; returns the copied byte count in w0; internally lock/unlocks the VTS mutex at this+0xd8 (0x208a40/0x208a50 PLT stubs; safe for the render thread to call); reads the slot array from this+0x100 at id*16 (sbfiz x8, x23, #4, #0x20)

captureSlots.capturedAbi: x0 = the SVLRoot*; this base's mangled name is _ZN7SVLRoot22ParsePeerValueSettingsEPK16TransportValue_ti (same shape as 5002363); the function returns void with a single ret path (0x164b8c..0x164e78, exactly one ret), so the wrapper captures x0 and forwards verbatim

x0 = the SVLRoot*; NOTE the per-base signature: this base's method is (dataset*, SVLDataLink*) - 3 args, NO trailing unsigned m (5002363 has 4). The shared 4-arg wrapper forwards the unused 4th register arg as-is; the AArch64 register ABI makes this safe (the callee never reads x3), and the original returns void with exactly one ret path (0x164a44..0x164b8c)
